name: tokentracker-cli
description: Token usage tracker for AI agent CLIs (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Gemini, Kiro, OpenCode, OpenClaw, Every Code, Hermes, GitHub Copilot, Kimi Code, CodeBuddy, Grok Build, oh-my-pi, pi, Craft Agents, Kilo CLI, Kilo Code, Roo Code, Zed Agent, Goose)

scripts.ci:local: npm run agents:check && npm --prefix dashboard run lint && npm --prefix dashboard run typecheck && npm --prefix dashboard run test && npm --prefix dashboard run build && npm --prefix dashboard run verify:data-display-policy && npm test && npm run validate:copy && npm run validate:ui-hardcode && npm run validate:guardrails
scripts.tauri:build: tauri build && npm run tauri:verify-runtime && node scripts/clean-old-tauri-installers.cjs
scripts.tauri:build:ci: npm run tauri:build && npm run tauri:verify-installer && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -Command "$bundleDir = 'src-tauri/target/release/bundle'; $artifacts = @(); $artifacts += Get-ChildItem $bundleDir/msi/*.msi -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; $artifacts += Get-ChildItem $bundleDir/nsis/*-setup.exe -File -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue; if ($artifacts.Count -eq 0) { Write-Error 'No Tauri installer found'; exit 1 }; $artifactArgs = @(); foreach ($artifact in $artifacts) { $artifactArgs += @('--artifact', $artifact.FullName) }; node scripts/generate-windows-release-metadata.cjs @artifactArgs --version $env:npm_package_version --head-sha $env:TOKEN_EYES_GIT_SHA --run-id local --run-url null --output-dir src-tauri/target/release/bundle/local-release-metadata; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }"
